paper_title: Searching for Particle Dark Matter with eROSITA Early Data
notes: Paper sets limits on decaying DM (sterile neutrino and axion-like particles) from eROSITA eFEDS X-ray observations. ALP coupling g_agamma vs mass m_a shown in Figure 7 (range ~2-18 keV, y-axis 1e-19 to 1e-17 GeV^-1). Data points are approximate readings from the eFEDS limit curve in Fig 7 since no numerical table is provided. NFW profile with rho_solar=0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. Cagamma=0.75 (DFSZ) used. Confidence moderate because values are read from plot, not tabulated. The paper also gives sterile neutrino (mixing angle) and decay rate limits, but the requested AxionPhoton coupling corresponds to Fig 7. | Auto-corrected masses: GeV→eV (÷1e9) (×1.000e-09, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-05)|)
